title: 高三多题听力：潮线与修复工坊
instruction: 听四段较长对话和一段独白，五组分别回答2、3、3、4、3题，共15题，每题三选。每段听两遍；听前每题5秒读题，听后每题5秒作答，已含在音轨中。来源题面/印本附注脚本/参考键可核，原音轨未取得；本稿提供完整原创音频与脚本。
source_form_notice: 高三公开阶段卷第二节五材料2/3/3/4/3、三选、两遍结构已核；附印本注释脚本及参考键，原录音缺、原校及地域学期未认证，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套供审阅。
teacher_source_notice: 公开标签为雅礼相关阶段卷，正文只确认高三英语，地域与学期未在正文确认，学校原版未认证。原题面、附注印本脚本与参考键在库；脚本为带题号/词汇注释的OCR文本，未认证清洁逐字/独立听校，原音轨未取得，源全输入未通过，不当gold。
source_scoring_notice: 来源本节15题、每题1.5分、满分22.5分为明确印出配置，非年级统一标准。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I have booked the coast walk for ten tomorrow. Should I bring the tide chart?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The guide has one, but bring your boots. The route stays above the water, though parts of the path will be muddy.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I assumed we would go down onto the beach to see the rocks.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That was the original plan. The group now includes people who cannot manage the steps, so the guide has chosen a level path with views of the same rocks.

questions.rationale: 向导有潮汐表；明确带靴子应付泥路，C无攀登。

options: To make it accessible to more walkers.
To avoid all views of the rocks.
To reach the beach at low tide.
questions.rationale: 有参与者不能走台阶，改平路；B仍可看同样岩石，C新路不下海滩。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: These radio parts arrived without labels. Are we supposed to guess which set they came from?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. Photograph each part next to a ruler, then put it in a separate bag. We will compare the pictures with the repair records.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That will take longer than cleaning everything first.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Perhaps, but cleaning could remove pencil marks that help us identify them. We need a record of how they arrived before doing anything else.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: If a part is broken, can we throw it away?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Keep it. Even a damaged piece may show how the set was put together. We are documenting these radios, not trying to make every one work again.

options: Photograph the parts with a ruler.
Fit the parts into working radios.
questions.rationale: W先拍带尺照片再装袋；A会抹掉标记，C非首先操作。

questions.stem: Why does the woman reject immediate cleaning?
options: The parts are already perfectly clean.
questions.rationale: 铅笔痕可帮助辨认，清洁可能擦掉；B/C无据。

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the work?
questions.rationale: 结尾明确document rather than make every one work；A/B未提用途。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I liked your interview with the bus driver, but the opening sounds as if he dislikes his job.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: He said the early start was exhausting. That seemed a strong beginning.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: It is strong, but later he explains that he enjoys the quiet first journey. Removing that part changes his point.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We only have three minutes. What could I cut instead?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The long description of the bus model repeats information in the caption. Keep his explanation of why the first journey matters.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You are right. I will also send him the edited version before we publish it.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good. Ask whether the edit represents his meaning accurately, rather than whether he likes the music.

questions.stem: What concerns the woman about the opening?
questions.rationale: 只截疲惫遗漏享受首班安静，造成失真；A/C无据。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest cutting?
options: The description already in the caption.
The driver's reason for enjoying the journey.
The entire interview with the driver.
questions.rationale: 车型说明与图注重复可删；B应保留，C非建议。

questions.stem: What will the man ask the driver to check?
options: Whether his meaning is represented fairly.
questions.rationale: 末句明确审含义准确而非音乐喜好；A不属核查。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I expected the night photography class to begin with camera settings, but you asked us to leave our cameras in their bags.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: For ten minutes. I wanted you to notice where the light came from before looking through a screen.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I began to see reflections that I had walked past before.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Exactly. A technically sharp image is not automatically an interesting one.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Do you think my picture of the empty ticket window works?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The light is good, but the bright sign at the edge draws attention away from the window. Try changing where you stand rather than immediately deleting it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Should I ask someone to stand by the window to make it less empty?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Only if that is the story you want. The absence of a person can itself be meaningful. Do not add one merely because you think every photograph needs a face.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will try a different angle first, then compare the two versions.

questions.stem: Why were cameras kept in bags initially?
questions.rationale: 教师明确先观察光源而非看屏幕；A/C未说。

questions.stem: What did the man notice during the exercise?
options: A fault in his camera screen.
A crowd outside the ticket window.
questions.rationale: M明确发现以往走过忽略的反射；B/C无。

questions.stem: What problem does the woman identify in his photograph?
options: The window is out of focus.
The picture includes too many people.
An edge sign distracts from the subject.
questions.rationale: 边缘亮牌转移注意；A未评对焦，B画面为空。

questions.stem: What will the man do next?
options: Add a face to every picture.
questions.rationale: 最后先换角度比较；A被否定，C未拍第二版也不立即删。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text:
This afternoon we are opening a temporary display about the old river crossing. You will see tickets, photographs and a model ferry. The model was made recently from measurements and descriptions; it is not a surviving boat from the period. We have placed that information beside it because an accurate reconstruction can still be mistaken for an original object.

The ticket collection is incomplete. Some months are represented by a single ticket, while others have none. A missing month does not show that the ferry stopped running. It tells us only that no ticket from that month is in this collection. Other records may eventually help us establish the timetable.

If your family has a relevant photograph, please tell the volunteer at the desk. You can let us make a copy while keeping the original. We would also like to record what you know about it, including any uncertainty about the date. A carefully described uncertainty is more useful than a guessed year that later visitors repeat as fact.

questions.stem: What is made clear about the model ferry?
options: It is the only surviving original.
It was found in the river.
questions.rationale: 明确recently from measurements不是旧船；B/C冲突或无据。

questions.stem: What can be concluded from a month with no collected ticket?
options: The ferry did not operate then.
The collection has no ticket for that month.
All passengers travelled free that month.
questions.rationale: 缺藏票只证明藏品缺项；A/C超过证据。

questions.stem: What are families encouraged to do?
options: Choose an exact date even if uncertain.
Share a copy and what they know about it.
questions.rationale: 可留原件共享副本并记录所知包括不确定日期；A/B相反。
